metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a partial simulator in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js). It runs on Node.js without dependencies and supports basic modal state, linear and arc motion, coordinate offsets, parameter expressions, and trace sampling.

**The simulator is not complete and does not yet meet the requested specification.** Canned cycles, probing, and nonzero cutter-radius compensation are not implemented; other RS274 edge cases also remain unverified. It should not be relied on to validate machining programs.

I verified JavaScript syntax and checked the supplied linear-motion trace example and the invalid tool-offset error case.
